defs.meaning: 超链接；超级链接（hyperlink 复数）

examples.en: It has a very interesting feature: hyperlinks!
examples.zh: 它具备一个十分有趣的特点：超文本链接！

examples.en: There are no distracting hyperlinks on a typewriter.
examples.zh: 打字机上不会出现令人分心的超链接。

examples.en: You an also define hyperlinks as depicted in Figure 9.
examples.zh: 您也可以定义超链接，如图9所示。
